description: A chessboard sits on the table with several pieces on it, along with a gray phone-like object, a remote control, and a small white case to the right. The left hand stays mostly still near the left edge while the right hand reaches in from the right, grips the white case as a right-hand object, lifts it up and inward over the chessboard, and then sets it down near the center squares before releasing and pulling back.
